Rachel and Marcus settled on 100% after Loomly rejected the earlier 50% proposal [4]. Loomly was told in writing [5], and Pinecrest's credit was confirmed by email [8].

**November books:** Marcus planned a $24,600 contra-revenue accrual in November, reversed when the December credit memos go out [1]. The November close checklist showed this item as "in progress" on Nov 16 [7]. I can't see the journal entry itself, so I can't confirm it has been posted.

**Not in November:** Loomly's request to reimburse its sellers' overdraft fees ($7,690, 214 sellers) [5]. Marcus is leaving it out and flagging it as an open item in the close memo, since no decision has been made [1]. Loomly has been promised an answer by Nov 25, and the close locks Dec 7 [1][5].
